problem:
If
    $Z=[\begin{aligned}-8 & 2 & 10\end{aligned}]$,
then find the transpose of $Z.$

|  |  | {{field-1}} |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ${Z}^{T}=\,\,$ |  | {{field-2}} |  |
|  |  | {{field-3}} |  |
worked_solution:
To find the transpose, we interchange the rows and columns:

$$
{Z}^{T}=[\begin{aligned}-8 \\ 2 \\ 10\end{aligned}]
$$
